notes.title: Major Change in Development
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921925/73d4401b6eb1e763bb0ccb04378d886c052611f5.png[/img]
 
 
Scarenoid is no longer a 2D platformer. We implemented a 3D environment, and incorporated RPG mechanics.  
Player can now collect items, keep health and experience points, and pay attention to stamina and breath levels. 

We hope you'll like the changes. 
You can show support by wishlisting the game.
 
https://store.steampowered.com/widget/1444820/
